- Confirm PO number to invoice against (please reply with the PO PDF).
- Confirm net terms (we’ll default to Net 30 unless you indicate otherwise).
- Provide billing contact for remittance (name + email + vendor ID if any).
- Flag any invoicing holdbacks or required line items for revenue recognition (e.g., SOW acceptance milestone).

Redwood timeline / what we will do:
- Tue 4/27 17:00 PT — PO cutoff for April invoice window.
- Wed 4/28 — We generate and send invoice draft to finance-bill@acmecorp.com and cc your procurement contact.
- Fri 4/30 — If PO confirmed and invoice accepted, we will recognize the associated bookings for April month-end close.

Attachments: I’ll attach our draft invoice and a sample GL code mapping for ease — please annotate and return.

If any of the internal teams need to adjust the send date for accounting reasons, call it out here and I’ll shift the internal prep.
